title: Worldpay — DP-4500 decline, device_id NMTOKEN invalid ('e30='), marked known issue per QA
symptom: Successful capture with WorldPay using payment widget and capture total order with webhook. Worldpay processor_error: device_id 'e30=' NMTOKEN must be a name token (422); also reported as DP-4500 decline. Worldpay requests are sending an invalid device_id token format, causing NMTOKEN validation failure and the PSP to reject the transaction. Fails at Step 7: Verify payment is authorized successfully. Affects Worldpay capture/refund/webhook flows (total and partial capture, total and partial refund, airline information, REFUNDED webhook) across MX/BR/GT/PE. Recurring across the whole Worldpay suite with the same signature.
recipe: Marked as a known issue per QA disposition (QA Review=OK, Root cause QA=External issue) so devs don't re-triage the whole Worldpay suite on every regression. Do NOT auto-propose a diff and do not re-run (this entry skips verify). NOTE for whoever reviews: the evidence points at a DEUNA-side payload bug, not a Worldpay-side decline — device_id is being sent as 'e30=', which is base64 for '{}' (an empty JSON object) instead of a valid NMTOKEN, and the classifier put this in the invalid_payload category. If backend confirms this is our payload construction, re-triage it as a real fix (payloadFixer: populate device_id with a valid NMTOKEN) rather than leaving it marked as external — this disposition was set manually and should be revisited once the device_id serialization is confirmed. This entry stops matching automatically if the failure changes shape (different error code / device_id value).
